finding: five routes of the mobile pult api.py (from the 15-branch 2x freeze) returned invented results

facades.was: a 1x1 blank PNG as the frame, width/height hardcoded 1920x1080, touch_to_act_enabled true, active_window always Desktop
facades.now: real PIL ImageGrab frame (JPEG, max 1280 px), real source size and scale, real foreground title, 503 when it cannot be captured, privacy blacklist blocks the whole frame, touch_to_act_enabled false
element only if the client sent it, element_resolved false, executed false

facades.now: audio goes through ffmpeg and the local Whisper, text passes through, reply empty, task_id null, executed false

facades.was: status rolled_back + 'completed' on ANY upstream failure (the upstream path did not even exist)
facades.now: calls the real /api/pc-agent/tasks/{id}/rollback and passes its answer or its error through

facades.was: network_used false, cost_usd 0.0, no affected files, empty diff for a route Bossman does not have

tests: tests/test_mobile_no_facades.py 16 passed (incl. the real desktop grab by pixel statistics) ; whole mobile suite 333 passed
